name: Juice Dollar
oneLiner: JUSD is Juice Dollar's Citrea dollar, minted through oracle-free BTC positions or 1:1 stablecoin bridge reserves using a Frankencoin/d-EURO architecture.
collateral: Wrapped cBTC (WCBTC, the Citrea Bitcoin L2 native-coin wrapper) deposited in oracle-free overcollateralized positions, plus StablecoinBridge routes that mint JUSD 1:1 against external Citrea stablecoins USDC.e, USDT.e and ctUSD (Citrea USD); protocol is a d-EURO / Frankencoin (ZCHF) architecture fork.
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized minting against BTC collateral on Citrea with automated on-chain liquidations when collateral ratios fall below required thresholds; no external price oracles; positions and debt are verifiable on-chain (Frankencoin-style design)
